purpose: Establish the weakest L5 capability: accept one derivation already supplied in the fixed ERCF-3 Hilbert syntax, without claiming search, truth decision or self-reliability.

source_basis.kind: fixed local object language plus actual-checker source comparison

answer_visibility.limitation: The task is a capability control, not novelty evidence.

input.type_ref: one supplied inhabitant of ObjectSyntax.⊢ kFormula
input.available_information: the complete derivation is available before checking

environment.reality_model: a checker receives one finite proof object
environment.theory_model: Agda checks that object against the fixed derivation family

observation.value: whether the supplied proof inhabits its claimed formula

allowed_resources: the supplied derivation and identity checker only
prohibited_extra_information: no proof search, semantic truth predicate, reflection or self-guarantee claim
obligations: the searched path must include both supply and check rules
removing the check rule removes the goal

known_negative_controls.description: the K derivation cannot inhabit bottom

theoryization_steps: encode the fixed formula as Fml
present an inhabitant of its derivation family
correspondence.observation_justification: acceptance is exactly the original task
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: This task models checking a supplied derivation and nothing stronger.
open_obligations: do not promote this result to proof search, truth decision or self-reliability
